Mina: quick heads-up - found a small but nasty SSE repro in the sampleapp: if a client does an auth refresh while the server is mid-chunk, we sometimes double-apply the last small delta after reconnect.
ryan: can you paste repro steps?
Mina: sure: 1) start sampleapp streaming demo 2) server emits a multi-line event that gets split across two writes 3) force a 120ms network hiccup + client triggers auth refresh on reconnect 4) reconnect includes resume header but sometimes the resume is missed and the server replays the buffered partial which was already partially applied before the drop -> duplicate small-delta.
ryan: any logs?
Mina: captured trimmed: 
```
# stream (partial)
data: {"id":"u-900","chunk":"partA"

# mid-write network drop ~120ms
# client refreshes auth -> reconnect
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: staging.api
> Authorization: Bearer ey...new
> last-event-id: u-900

# router access shows header lowercased: last-event-id: u-900
# resume check does r.Header.Get("Last-Event-Id") -> empty -> server replays buffer
```
Mina: observed that some SDKs set canonical "Last-Event-ID" and others set lowercase. proxies sometimes lowercase or rewrite, so resume lookup can miss. Also parser behavior: if parser flushed a partial on EOF it will be replayed after resume. Two bugs interacting.
ryan: short fixes: 1) router middleware to normalize any-case resume header to canonical Last-Event-Id before resume logic 2) make resume application idempotent by deduping on event-id 3) update sdks/sampleapps to set both canonical + lowercase header when reconnecting.
Mina: opened WIP PRs: sampleapp/#9 (dual header + jittered reconnect) and platform/router/#82 (header normalize + unit). ci-bot: build 22021 queued for sampleapp/#9.
ops-bot: note - add e2e that splits final token across TCP writes and forces auth-refresh reconnect to catch dup/missing cases. mark flaky.
ryan: good. also add a tiny paragraph in SDK onboarding docs about polyfill differences and recommended reconnect jitter.
Mina: will add docs blurb after PRs land. thanks.
